Lighting is believable, surface detail withstands a cinematic freeze frame; this is material-led museum artistry, never stock blacksmith photography. No human figures.

Chapter 00 / PROLOGUE — BEFORE FORM.
Scene: a pure-dark architectural void. The unformed steel billet enters diagonally from lower right, rough rectangular section and granular oxide-black scales, long straight edge caught by one cold narrow side light. It occupies the lower-right 35 percent and is completely visible enough to understand its shape while losing portions subtly into shadow. At least 65–70 percent quiet dark negative space. A minuscule distant ember near the far right, not orange fog.
Hero composition: enormous bone-white title "FERRUM" across the upper-left and center negative space, optically tight, wide presence, condensed tall letterforms; do not cover the important metal edge. Beneath the title a small uppercase subtitle "THE MEMORY OF FIRE"; lower left single quiet sentence "Everything begins as matter." Keep the hero hierarchy breathtakingly simple and refined. No extra chapter headline.
Camera: extremely low close three-quarter angle, near billet end at lower right, its axis points toward center left. Material scars and uneven roughness are visible in the narrow cold grazing reflection; cold graphite stays neutral.
